card.name: Reducing or slowing infusion for reactions
card.fires_on: Words in instructions on how to adjust an infusion after a reaction, such as reduce, slow, interrupt, or the gap after "by" before a percentage. Also "in a" before healthcare setting and "low" before dose.

modes.label: Cut rate or interrupt
modes.description: Verbs and nouns telling the reader to reduce, slow, or interrupt an infusion when a reaction occurs.
modes.example: If a significant infusion-associated reaction occurs,<< slow>> or interrupt the infusion and administer appropriate medical

modes.label: Rate cut amount
modes.description: The spot after "by" just before a percentage reduction in infusion rate.
modes.example: Infusion Reactions: Reduce infusion rate by<< >>50% for mild to moderate reactions

modes.label: Start in a setting
modes.description: The word "a" in "Initiate ... in a healthcare setting" for enzyme therapies.
modes.example: Initiate NAGLAZYME in<< a>> healthcare setting with appropriate medical monitoring and support

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted tokens are a mix of unrelated words.
card.plain: It marks spots in warnings where the label says how to slow, pause, or cautiously start an infusion.
